test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To stand one's ground

options.text: To fight for the same position
To stand in one’s own land

solution:
The correct answer is- **"To maintain one's position"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"To maintain one's position"** is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
 
• **To stand one's ground**: To maintain or stay by a viewpoint or position; to be resolute in the face of opposition.
 
 
• **Example: **They were expecting that their opponents will back out but the opponent **stand their ground **on the issue.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.
